snippet.title: AI Agents vs Chatbots, Explained in 60 Seconds
snippet.description:
What actually separates an AI agent from a chatbot? In under a minute: a chatbot answers you in conversation, while an agent pursues a goal, plans the steps and uses tools to complete the task. The internship example is illustrative.

Sources:
- IBM, What is a chatbot?: https://www.ibm.com/think/topics/chatbots
- IBM, What are AI agents?: https://www.ibm.com/think/topics/ai-agents
- Anthropic, Building effective agents: https://www.anthropic.com/engineering/building-effective-agents
- Google Cloud, What are AI agents?: https://cloud.google.com/discover/what-are-ai-agents
